title: Feedback:Game updates/20251208
wikitext:
== Update, December 8, 2025 ==

* Fixed a bug where the [[Bonus Mission Pack]] and [[Eye of the North]] DLC showed as owned in "Manage Account" but were not recognized in-game, preventing access to purchased content for Steam players.
* Fixed a bug preventing task tracker position customization when gamepad hints were disabled.
* Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting the game while using the virtual cursor.
* Fixed a rare crash at the end of music tracks when OpenAL environmental effects were enabled.
* Addressed an issue where every [[trader]] in-game [[Feedback talk:Game updates/20251208|decided to stop trading]] (fixed in the evening of December 7 without a build).
